values.meaning: bonus magic damage on basic attacks and Tongue Lash
values.quote: {{as|{{pp|5 to 60 for 12}}|magic damage}} ({{as|+ {{fd|1.25}}% AP}} {{as|per 100 '''bonus''' health}}) {{as|(+ 4% of his '''bonus''' health)}}
values.binNote: The bin computes total damage as byLevel base + 0.04xbonusHp + (APRatioPer100BonusHP=0.0125 x bonusHp x 0.01)xap, matching the wiki's flat-per-level base, +4% bonus HP term, and +1.25% AP per 100 bonus HP term; cited as one calculation since the individual coefficients (0.04, 0.0125) are components of TotalDamage rather than separate named rows.

values.quote: for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times

values.meaning: interval at which stacks expire one by one
values.quote: Stacks expire one by one every {{fd|0.67}} seconds when the duration ends.
values.binNote: Wiki states 0.67s per-stack decay while the bin's PerStackDecayTimer is 1; treated as the same mechanic but the numbers disagree.

mechanics.claim: The passive applies to both basic attacks (on-hit) and Tongue Lash, but the damage instance type differs.
mechanics.quote: the damage is dealt as an '''additional''' instance of damage (as opposed to '''bonus''' damage when applied by basic attacks)

mechanics.claim: The passive bonus damage applies to turrets.
mechanics.quote: The passive bonus damage applies to turrets.

mechanics.claim: As an additional damage instance from Tongue Lash, it double-triggers on-hit-style effects like Bloodletter's Curse.
mechanics.quote: This causes effects like {{ri|Bone Plating}} and {{iis|Bloodletter's Curse}} {{nie|Vile Decay}} to be applied twice.

mechanics.claim: Only applies stacks against enemy champions.
mechanics.quote: apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''An Acquired Taste'' against enemy {{tip|champions}}
